These voids can be accessed via remote control, magnetic latches, or cleverly disguised release mechanisms.

The types of substances dictate the complexity of the concealment. Technicians might hollow out components like steering wheels, seat frames, or even engine blocks, sealing them hermetically to prevent detection by scent-detection dogs or x-ray scanners. Furthermore, cartels understand the routes and border security measures. They tailor the concealment to the anticipated inspection methods. They also actively research and counter new detection technologies, adapting their methods accordingly.
